title: Trump traded over $50 million in 'Magnificent 7' stocks last quarter, loading up on Apple and Google and selling Tesla
title_zh: 特朗普上个季度交易了超过 5000 万美元的“Magnificent 7”股票，买入苹果和谷歌并出售特斯拉
summary: President Trump made 94 different trades of 'Magnificent 7' stocks in the first quarter of 2026, a new ethics disclosure shows, executing millions of dollars in transactions even as he was meeting with and often promoting these top tech companies.
summary_zh: 一份新的道德披露显示，特朗普总统在 2026 年第一季度对“Magnificent 7”股票进行了 94 笔不同的交易，即使在他与这些顶级科技公司会面并经常推销这些公司的同时，也执行了数百万美元的交易。
